name: Military Annexation of the Crimean Khanate (1783) (C0035)

techniques.comment: The erasure of the historical names of the Cossack southern territories used as a springboard for the annexation of Crimea: Catherine II's manifesto of 3 August 1775 extirpated "the very name of the Zaporozhian Cossacks" and poured their lands into an imperial construct – "assigning them as convenient to the Novorossiysk Governorate"(Citation: Манифест об уничтожении Запорожской Сечи 1775).

The use of Ukrainian Cossacks as a military resource for storming Turkish fortresses and consolidating imperial claims to Crimea: at Ochakiv "the 'loyal Cossacks' took part in the storming of the fortress"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 7 2010), and in the storming of Izmail "in total over 6 thousand Black Sea Cossacks took part in the battle"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 3 2005).
